queries:
WITH invoice_averages AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        AVG(derived_product_cost) AS average_product_cost,
        AVG(1.0 * derived_total_cost / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) AS average_ratio
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_ratio) AS ratio FROM invoice_averages
)
SELECT
    AVG(i.average_product_cost) AS average_product_cost,
    AVG(i.average_ratio) AS average_ratio,
    AVG(i.average_ratio - o.ratio) AS average_excess_ratio
FROM invoice_averages AS i
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE i.average_ratio > o.ratio

WITH invoice_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        AVG(derived_total_cost / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) AS ratio
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio
    FROM invoice_ratios
),
selected AS (
    SELECT ir.invoice_number, ir.ratio
    FROM invoice_ratios AS ir
    CROSS JOIN overall AS o
    WHERE ir.ratio > o.average_ratio
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AVG(ili.derived_product_cost)
     FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
     JOIN selected AS s ON s.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number) AS average_product_cost,
    AVG(s.ratio) AS average_ratio,
    AVG(s.ratio - o.average_ratio) AS average_above_overall
FROM selected AS s
CROSS JOIN overall AS o

WITH invoice_averages AS (
    SELECT
        i.invoice_number,
        AVG(li.derived_product_cost) AS average_product_cost,
        AVG(1.0 * li.derived_total_cost / NULLIF(li.product_price, 0)) AS average_ratio
    FROM Invoices AS i
    LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS li
        ON li.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
    GROUP BY i.invoice_number
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(1.0 * derived_total_cost / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) AS average_ratio
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
)
SELECT
    AVG(ia.average_product_cost) AS average_product_cost,
    AVG(ia.average_ratio) AS average_ratio,
    AVG(ia.average_ratio - oa.average_ratio) AS average_amount_above_overall_average
FROM invoice_averages AS ia
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE ia.average_ratio > oa.average_ratio

WITH invoice_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        AVG(derived_product_cost) AS average_product_cost,
        1.0 * SUM(derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(product_price), 0) AS ratio
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio
    FROM invoice_metrics
)
SELECT
    AVG(im.average_product_cost) AS average_product_cost,
    AVG(im.ratio) AS average_ratio,
    AVG(im.ratio - o.average_ratio) AS average_amount_above_overall
FROM invoice_metrics AS im
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE im.ratio > o.average_ratio
